entities.summary: Edmund Esbern Johannes Joensen is a Faroese politician, who was the Prime Minister of the Faroe Islands from 1994 to 1998. He did not stand in the 2022 Danish general election and his granddaughter Anna Falkenberg replaced him as Member of the Folketing for the Union Party of which Joensen is a member. Edmund Joensen was a performers & entertainers from Oyri (b. 1944-09-19, Oyri). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
